caption: Four 200 kHz carriers give 8 time slots each, so one frame holds 4 × 8 = 32 slots; the marked slot is the control channel, leaving 31 calls running at once. Each slot lasts 576.875 µs and frames repeat 216.7 times a second.

spec.title: One GSM frame: 4 carriers × 8 slots = 32 slots
spec.aria: A grid of 4 carriers, each with 8 numbered time slots in one 4.615 ms frame, giving 32 slots; one slot is marked as the control channel and the other 31 hold calls.
